_comment: Lead candidate cards. `party` is a template code from data/parties.json and supplies the card colour, so nothing here repeats a hex value. `role` is the line under the name; `bio` the short paragraph. Order is the order they appear.

items.name: Manuela Schwesig
items.bio: Minister-president since 2017 and federal families minister before that; standing for a second full term after leading the SPD to 39.6% in 2021.

items.name: Leif-Erik Holm
items.bio: Bundestag member and the AfD's 2016 state lead candidate, back as its candidate for minister-president. Enrico Schult heads the state list.

items.name: Daniel Peters
items.bio: State party chair and CDU parliamentary group leader since 2024, defending a result that has halved in the polls since 2021.

items.name: Simone Oldenburg
items.bio: Deputy minister-president and education minister in the outgoing coalition, standing as lead candidate for the second time.

items.name: Claudia Müller
items.bio: Bundestag member and parliamentary business manager for her group, leading the Greens' list jointly with Ole Krüger.

items.name: Jakob Schirmer
items.bio: Lead candidate for a party that entered the Landtag in 2021 after a decade out and has polled below the threshold since.

items.name: Peter Schabbel
items.bio: Lead candidate for the Sahra Wagenknecht Alliance, contesting a Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election for the first time.
